picks.reason: This is a price bet, not a projection bet: the Bot projects Jason Robertson for 3.43 shots, a hair under the line, so the edge comes from the odds rather than any read the market lacks. His blended rate is 3.41 over 13 games this season and 88 last; CBJ's defense takes 2.8% off, the fit's league-wide scaling adds 2.6%, and more power-play time adds 0.7%. Only 46.61% of his weighted games landed over 3.5, which is roughly what +132 already asks for. The Book's no-vig chance is 43.73%, and the desk bets 43.74% against a 43.1% break-even, an edge of 0.64 points. That margin rests almost entirely on the Book's own price, since the Bot barely disagrees with it.
picks.risk: The Bot's own projection of 3.43 sits under the line and the fit runs 0.06 shots high across all players, so a routine three-shot night sinks a bet whose edge is only 0.64 points.
picks.headline: Over 3.5 shots is a plus-money price play, not a projection
